name: Hanan Darwish
title: Senior corporate executive and leadership specialist
bio_short: Former Cluster President of Schneider Electric for the Gulf and Pakistan. More than 25 years' executive experience at Schneider Electric and Procter and Gamble across four continents. CEO and founder of Boldly Digital. Delivers in English and Arabic.
bio: Hanan has more than 25 years' experience in executive leadership, organisational transformation and corporate communications across the Middle East, Africa, Europe and North America. She spent 17 years at Schneider Electric, rising to Cluster President for the Gulf and Pakistan, where she led the business across the region. Earlier executive roles at Schneider included Global Senior Vice President of Corporate Strategy and Human Resources for the Energy Business, overseeing more than 29,000 employees worldwide, Vice President of HR for North America, and Head of HR for France. She established the Schneider Electric University, a global platform for leading and managing the company's worldwide trainer network.  Before Schneider, Hanan spent seven years at Procter and Gamble in marketing, customer business development and organisational development. She is a keynote speaker who has addressed the World Economic Forum on MENA and has been interviewed by The Business Year and CNBC.  At ISOC, Hanan delivers leadership, interpersonal skills, corporate communications and digital transformation programmes. Her career leading major multinational businesses gives her training an authority and directness that comes from lived experience of the communication and leadership challenges at the highest levels. Hanan is based in Dubai and trains in English and Arabic.

She is now CEO and founder of Boldly Digital, a consulting firm specialising in digital transformation and human-centred design. She is a keynote speaker who has addressed the World Economic Forum on MENA and has been interviewed by The Business Year and CNBC.  At ISOC, Hanan delivers leadership, interpersonal skills, corporate communications and digital transformation programmes. Her career leading major multinational businesses gives her training an authority and directness that comes from lived experience of the communication and leadership challenges at the highest levels. She understands how large organisations function, how decisions are made under pressure, and how communication and interpersonal skills directly influence business outcomes. Her experience at Schneider Electric is particularly relevant for organisations in the energy and sustainability sectors. Hanan is based in Dubai and trains in English and Arabic.
